papers.title: $π$-Flux Tuning of Quantum Paramagnetism in the Triangular-Lattice Hubbard Model
papers.authors: Zhaochen Liu, Andreas Feuerpfeil, Ronny Thomale
papers.summary_en: This work compares zero-flux and staggered-π-flux triangular-lattice Hubbard models at half filling to examine how flux-dependent charge fluctuations affect quantum paramagnetism. It finds contrasting scalar-chirality behavior associated with the different signs of ring exchange in the two models.
papers.summary: We compare two time-reversal-symmetric triangular-lattice Hubbard models at half filling: the zero-flux model and a staggered $π$-flux model with zero and $π$ flux through oppositely oriented triangles. papers.abstract: We compare two time-reversal-symmetric triangular-lattice Hubbard models at half filling: the zero-flux model and a staggered $π$-flux model with zero and $π$ flux through oppositely oriented triangles. Although both reduce to the same Heisenberg model at leading order in the strong-coupling limit, their distinct charge fluctuation profiles yield different quantum paramagnetic regimes. Combining a strong-coupling expansion with infinite density matrix renormalization group (iDMRG) calculations, we find that the positive ring-exchange of the zero-flux model promotes spontaneous chirality, consistent with its notion of a chiral spin liquid at intermediate coupling. In the staggered-$π$-flux model, whose noninteracting limit is a Dirac semimetal, the ring exchange changes sign and disfavors chiral order and we find no resolvable scalar chirality. This renders flux-tuned ring-exchange an efficient discriminator between chiral and non-chiral quantum paramagnets at finite coupling.
papers.physics_advance: The sign of ring exchange distinguishes the chiral tendency of the zero-flux model from the absence of resolvable scalar chirality in the staggered-π-flux model.
papers.relevance_reason: This is an original study of quantum paramagnetic regimes in a triangular-lattice Hubbard system and identifies flux-dependent ring exchange as a mechanism affecting chirality.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究比较半填充三角晶格 Hubbard 模型中的零磁通与交错 π 磁通情形，考察磁通依赖的电荷涨落如何影响量子顺磁态。研究发现，两种模型中环交换符号不同，并伴随不同的标量手征性表现。
papers.method_en: The authors combine a strong-coupling expansion with infinite density matrix renormalization group (iDMRG) calculations. The comparison focuses on the effective ring-exchange terms and scalar chirality in the two models.
papers.method_zh: 作者结合强耦合展开与无限密度矩阵重整化群（iDMRG）计算。比较重点是两种模型中的有效环交换项和标量手征性。
papers.result_en: Although both models reduce to the same Heisenberg model at leading order in the strong-coupling limit, their charge-fluctuation profiles differ. Positive ring exchange in the zero-flux model promotes spontaneous chirality, consistent with a chiral spin liquid at intermediate coupling, whereas ring exchange changes sign in the staggered-π-flux model and disfavors chiral order. No resolvable scalar chirality is found in the latter model. The results identify flux-tuned ring exchange as a discriminator between chiral and non-chiral quantum paramagnets at finite coupling.
papers.result_zh: 尽管两种模型在强耦合极限的最低阶都化为相同的 Heisenberg 模型，其电荷涨落分布却不同。零磁通模型中的正环交换促进自发手征性，这与中等耦合下的手征自旋液体图景相符；而在交错 π 磁通模型中，环交换变号并抑制手征有序。后一模型中未发现可分辨的标量手征性。结果表明，在有限耦合下，磁通调控的环交换可用于区分手征与非手征量子顺磁态。
papers.future_en: The authors propose flux-tuned ring exchange as an efficient discriminator between chiral and non-chiral quantum paramagnets at finite coupling. The abstract does not specify a separate experimental follow-up.
papers.future_zh: 作者提出，在有限耦合下利用磁通调控的环交换，有效区分手征与非手征量子顺磁态。摘要未具体说明后续实验方案。
papers.tier_reason_en: The work offers a focused numerical and strong-coupling comparison that clarifies how flux changes ring exchange and chirality, but the abstract describes a specific model-level result rather than a broadly demonstrated advance.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 该工作通过针对性的数值计算和强耦合比较，阐明磁通如何改变环交换与手征性；但摘要呈现的是特定模型层面的结果，而非已广泛验证的突破。

papers.title: Anyon Chern bands of opposite sign and reversed drift
papers.authors: Zhenyu Xiao, Minxuan Wang, Shinsei Ryu
papers.summary_en: This theoretical and numerical study investigates the dispersion and dynamics of Laughlin quasiholes at filling 1/3 in a periodically modulated magnetic field. It finds anyon bands with opposite Chern-number signs and a quasihole drift opposite to the usual E×B direction in one band.
papers.summary: The elementary charged excitations of fractional quantum Hall states are anyons. Without continuous translation symmetry, they acquire a dispersion and richer dynamics. We study the Laughlin quasihole at filling $1/3$ in a periodically modulated magnetic field, a common model of fractional Chern insulators in two-dimensional materials. papers.abstract: The elementary charged excitations of fractional quantum Hall states are anyons. Without continuous translation symmetry, they acquire a dispersion and richer dynamics. We study the Laughlin quasihole at filling $1/3$ in a periodically modulated magnetic field, a common model of fractional Chern insulators in two-dimensional materials. From the microscopic wave functions, we derive the commutator of its guiding-center coordinates, set by a many-body Berry curvature that governs its wave packets. A modulation with two flux quanta per unit cell splits the quasihole band into bands with Chern numbers $6$ and $-3$; such opposite signs are generic as long as a weak modulation opens a gap between the anyon bands. In the $C=-3$ band, the quasihole drifts against $\mathbf{E}\times\mathbf{B}$, although the magnetic field has the same sign everywhere. Perturbation theory in the modulation explains these results, and large-scale Monte Carlo calculations confirm them. Anyon bands thus acquire their own topology, which controls anyon motion and may shape the phases of itinerant anyons.
papers.physics_advance: Periodic magnetic modulation can split Laughlin quasiholes into bands with opposite Chern numbers, including a band whose quasiholes drift opposite to the usual E×B direction despite a magnetic field of unchanged sign.
papers.relevance_reason: The paper establishes new topological and dynamical behavior of fractional quantum Hall quasiholes, a substantial theoretical advance in condensed-matter physics.
papers.summary_zh: 本理论与数值研究考察填充因子 1/3 的 Laughlin 准空穴在周期调制磁场中的色散与动力学。研究发现，任意子能带可具有符号相反的陈数，且其中一个能带的准空穴漂移方向与通常的 E×B 方向相反。
papers.method_en: The authors derive the commutator of quasihole guiding-center coordinates from microscopic wave functions, with the commutator set by a many-body Berry curvature. They analyze the modulation perturbatively and use large-scale Monte Carlo calculations to confirm the results.
papers.method_zh: 作者从微观波函数推导准空穴导引中心坐标的对易关系，其对易关系由多体 Berry 曲率决定。研究通过微扰理论分析磁场调制，并以大规模 Monte Carlo 计算验证结果。
papers.result_en: For a modulation with two flux quanta per unit cell, the quasihole band splits into bands with Chern numbers 6 and −3. The authors report that opposite-sign Chern numbers are generic when a weak modulation opens a gap between anyon bands. In the C = −3 band, the quasihole drifts against E×B even though the magnetic field has the same sign everywhere. These results show that anyon-band topology can govern anyon motion and may influence phases of itinerant anyons.
papers.result_zh: 当每个晶胞的调制磁通为两个磁通量子时，准空穴能带分裂为陈数分别为 6 和 −3 的能带。作者指出，只要弱调制在任意子能带之间打开能隙，陈数符号相反的情形便具有普遍性。在 C = −3 的能带中，尽管磁场处处同号，准空穴仍逆着 E×B 方向漂移。这些结果表明，任意子能带拓扑能够控制任意子运动，并可能影响可运动任意子的相态。
papers.future_en: The authors suggest that the topology of anyon bands may shape phases of itinerant anyons. The abstract does not specify a particular experimental test or follow-up study.
papers.future_zh: 作者指出，任意子能带的拓扑可能影响可运动任意子的相态。摘要未提出具体的实验检验或后续研究方案。
papers.tier_reason_en: The result links many-body Berry curvature and anyon-band topology to a striking reversed-drift response, supported by both perturbation theory and large-scale Monte Carlo; this is a concise conceptual advance with potential relevance beyond the specific model.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 该结果将多体 Berry 曲率和任意子能带拓扑与显著的反向漂移响应联系起来，并由微扰理论和大规模 Monte Carlo 共同支持；这是一个简洁的概念性进展，具有超出特定模型的潜在意义。

papers.title: GHz non-reciprocal optical conductivity in hematite ($α$-$\text{Fe}_2\text{O}_3$)
papers.authors: Peng Rao, Johannes Gröbmeyer, P. Peter Stavropoulos, Alexander Mook, Matthias Althammer, Hans Huebl, Alexander Holleitner, Johannes Knolle
papers.summary_en: This study calculates sub-gap optical response and nonreciprocity in canted easy-plane antiferromagnetic hematite across the GHz-to-THz range. It finds that the canting-induced net magnetic moment is associated with a nonzero Hall conductivity and evaluates a prospective circulator response.
papers.summary: We study the non-reciprocal properties of the iron oxide $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ (hematite) in the canted easy-plane antiferromagnetic phase, specifically in the GHz to THz frequency range. First, using the the microscopic spin Hamiltonian, we obtain the correct classical ground state where the canting is induced by the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions (DMI). The magnon spectrum is simulated using linea
papers.abstract: We study the non-reciprocal properties of the iron oxide $α$-Fe$_2$O$_3$ (hematite) in the canted easy-plane antiferromagnetic phase, specifically in the GHz to THz frequency range. First, using the the microscopic spin Hamiltonian, we obtain the correct classical ground state where the canting is induced by the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions (DMI). The magnon spectrum is simulated using linear spin wave theory. We then compute the polarizability and the sub-gap optical conductivities using linear response. We find that the conductivity tensor contains frequency peaks at the zero momentum magnon gaps of order $0.1~$meV which can be tuned by the DMI and on-site anisotropic spin interactions. Furthermore, we show that the canting-induced net magnetic moment $\mathbf{m}$ represents a measure for the effective time-reversal-symmetry breaking and non-reciprocity of the system: a finite $\mathbf{m}$ results in a non-zero Hall conductivity. Finally, we discuss the prospective application of hematite in non-reciprocal circulator design, by computing the non-reciprocal circulator transmission amplitude using the conductivities as input.
papers.physics_advance: The calculation predicts a nonzero Hall conductivity in canted hematite and connects its magnitude to the net moment, with conductivity peaks at magnon gaps tunable by DMI and anisotropy.
papers.relevance_reason: This is condensed-matter theory of an antiferromagnetic material, predicting how its magnetic order and magnon modes produce non-reciprocal optical conductivity.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究计算了易平面倾斜反铁磁赤铁矿在 GHz 至 THz 频段的带隙内光学响应与非互易性。研究发现，倾斜产生的净磁矩与非零霍尔电导相关，并评估了其潜在环行器响应。
papers.method_en: The authors determine the classical canted ground state from a microscopic spin Hamiltonian, simulate magnons using linear spin-wave theory, and calculate polarizability and sub-gap optical conductivities with linear response. They use the resulting conductivities to compute a nonreciprocal circulator transmission amplitude.
papers.method_zh: 作者从微观自旋哈密顿量确定经典倾斜基态，以线性自旋波理论模拟磁振子，并通过线性响应计算极化率和带隙内光学电导。随后利用所得电导计算非互易环行器的透射振幅。
papers.result_en: The conductivity tensor has peaks at zero-momentum magnon gaps of order 0.1 meV, which can be tuned by Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interactions and on-site anisotropic spin interactions. A finite canting-induced net moment corresponds to nonzero Hall conductivity and serves as a measure of effective time-reversal-symmetry breaking and nonreciprocity. The authors discuss hematite as a prospective material for nonreciprocal circulator design.
papers.result_zh: 电导张量在零动量磁振子能隙处出现峰值，能隙量级约为 0.1 meV，并可通过 Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya 相互作用及格点内各向异性自旋相互作用调节。倾斜产生的净磁矩非零时，霍尔电导也非零；作者将净磁矩视为系统有效时间反演对称性破缺与非互易性的量度。作者讨论了赤铁矿用于非互易环行器设计的潜力。
papers.future_en: The authors identify nonreciprocal circulator design as a prospective application and evaluate its transmission amplitude using the calculated conductivities. The abstract does not specify further experimental steps.
papers.future_zh: 作者将非互易环行器设计列为潜在应用，并利用计算得到的电导评估其透射振幅。摘要未具体说明进一步的实验步骤。

papers.title: Domain walls in $R3c$-structured NaNbO$_3$
papers.authors: Jack G. Nedell, Craig J. Fennie
papers.summary_en: This first-principles study classifies and examines structural domain walls in the low-temperature rhombohedral R3c phase of NaNbO₃.
papers.summary: In this work, we undertake a systematic first-principles study of structural domain walls in the low-temperature rhombohedral $R3c$ phase of perovskite oxide NaNbO$_3$. Employing a group-theoretic classification, we introduce eight unique classes of domain walls in the $R3c$ structure, four of which have a domain wall orientation determined uniquely by the conditions of elastic compatibility and c
papers.abstract: In this work, we undertake a systematic first-principles study of structural domain walls in the low-temperature rhombohedral $R3c$ phase of perovskite oxide NaNbO$_3$. Employing a group-theoretic classification, we introduce eight unique classes of domain walls in the $R3c$ structure, four of which have a domain wall orientation determined uniquely by the conditions of elastic compatibility and charge neutrality, and perform structural relaxations for each representative domain wall class. We find that one class of 109° domain walls has a notably low energy of 9 mJ m$^{-2}$, comparable to the low-energy ferroelectric walls in BaTiO$_3$. Finally, we find that this class of 109° walls is compatible with the crystal twinning observed in experiments on the $R3c$ phase, and propose an atomistic mechanism for the $R3c \leftrightarrow Pbcm$ phase transition.
papers.physics_advance: It classifies eight domain-wall types in rhombohedral NaNbO₃, identifies a low-energy 109° wall compatible with observed twinning, and proposes an atomistic mechanism for the R3c-to-Pbcm transition.
papers.relevance_reason: This first-principles study investigates domain-wall energetics and structural transformations in a condensed-matter oxide.
papers.summary_zh: 这项第一性原理研究对 NaNbO₃ 低温 R3c 相中的结构畴壁进行分类和考察。
papers.method_en: Using group theory, the authors identify eight domain-wall classes, derive unique orientations for four from elastic compatibility and charge neutrality, and relax representative structures.
papers.method_zh: 作者运用群论识别出八类畴壁，并依据弹性相容性和电荷中性条件确定其中四类的唯一取向，再对各类代表结构进行弛豫。
papers.result_en: One 109° wall class has a calculated energy of 9 mJ m⁻², comparable to low-energy ferroelectric walls in BaTiO₃; the authors also find it compatible with observed crystal twinning and propose an atomistic mechanism for the R3c↔Pbcm transition.
papers.result_zh: 一类 109° 畴壁的计算能量为 9 mJ m⁻²，与 BaTiO₃ 中低能铁电畴壁相当；作者还指出它与实验观察到的晶体孪晶相容，并提出 R3c↔Pbcm 相变的原子机制。
papers.future_en: Experimental characterization of the predicted low-energy wall and its relation to twinning could test the proposed structural picture; further calculations could examine the proposed transition mechanism.
papers.future_zh: 对所预测低能畴壁及其与孪晶关系开展实验表征，可检验这一结构图景；进一步计算则可考察所提出的相变机制。
papers.tier_reason_en: The symmetry-based classification and quantitative first-principles wall energetics provide a focused contribution to functional-oxide physics, but the abstract describes a single material and a computational study, supporting a solid specialist-journal tier rather than a broader high-impact tier.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 基于对称性的分类和定量第一性原理畴壁能计算，为功能氧化物物理提供了有针对性的成果；但摘要所述工作集中于单一材料且以计算为主，更适合扎实的专业期刊层级，而非更广泛的高影响力层级。

papers.title: Electronic Screening as a Design Lever in La-Doped BaTiO$_3$: Coupled Polarization, Dielectric Response, and Optical Anisotropy
papers.authors: Sikandar Azam, Muhammad Fareed, Qaiser Rafiq, Jan Minar, Abed Alataway
papers.summary_en: This study uses first-principles calculations to examine how 12.5% La substitution at Ba sites affects the coupled structural, ferroelectric, dielectric, electronic, and optical properties of BaTiO₃.
papers.summary: Donor substitution can tune the coupled ferroelectric, dielectric, electronic, and optical properties of perovskite oxides by modifying lattice distortions and electronic screening. We investigate these effects in La-doped BaTiO3 using density functional theory, density-functional perturbation theory, and the Berry-phase formalism for polarization. For a model with 12.5% La substitution at the Ba
papers.abstract: Donor substitution can tune the coupled ferroelectric, dielectric, electronic, and optical properties of perovskite oxides by modifying lattice distortions and electronic screening. We investigate these effects in La-doped BaTiO3 using density functional theory, density-functional perturbation theory, and the Berry-phase formalism for polarization. For a model with 12.5% La substitution at the Ba site, La incorporation induces anisotropic lattice contraction, reduces tetragonality and Ti off-centering, and weakens the energetic stabilization of the tetragonal ferroelectric phase. The accompanying reduction in polarization is associated with enhanced electronic screening and reduced anomalous Born effective charges. Phonon calculations indicate that the relaxed doped structure is dynamically stable, while hardening of a low-frequency polar mode is consistent with weakened ferroelectricity. The high-frequency dielectric response increases moderately, whereas the static dielectric response decreases as the lattice contribution is suppressed. Electronic-structure calculations show a Fermi-level shift toward the conduction band without mid-gap defect states. The optical spectra exhibit an absorption-edge shift consistent with a Burstein-Moss-type mechanism, enhanced near-edge transparency, and reduced birefringence. Together, these results suggest a microscopic connection between donor-induced screening, polar-mode hardening, reduced dynamical charges, polarization suppression, and decreased optical anisotropy. The conclusions apply to the investigated 12.5% composition; calculations at additional concentrations are needed to establish quantitative doping trends.
papers.physics_advance: For 12.5% La substitution in BaTiO3, enhanced electronic screening and reduced anomalous Born charges accompany weaker Ti off-centering, a hardened polar mode, and suppressed polarization and optical anisotropy.
papers.relevance_reason: The calculations address how donor doping changes ferroelectric lattice, dielectric, and electronic properties in a solid-state material, though the result is limited to one modeled composition.
papers.summary_zh: 这项研究通过第一性原理计算考察 Ba 位 12.5% La 替代对 BaTiO₃ 结构、铁电、介电、电子和光学性质的耦合影响。
papers.method_en: The authors combine density functional theory, density-functional perturbation theory, and Berry-phase polarization calculations for the specified doped composition.
papers.method_zh: 作者针对所研究的掺杂组分，结合密度泛函理论、密度泛函微扰理论和 Berry 相位极化计算。
papers.result_en: La substitution contracts the lattice anisotropically, reduces tetragonality, Ti off-centering, and polarization, and hardens a low-frequency polar mode; the calculations also find a moderately increased high-frequency dielectric response but a reduced static response, a conduction-band-directed Fermi-level shift without mid-gap defect states, a Burstein–Moss-type absorption-edge shift, increased near-edge transparency, and reduced birefringence.
papers.result_zh: La 替代导致晶格各向异性收缩，并降低四方畸变、Ti 离心位移和极化，同时使低频极化模硬化；计算还显示高频介电响应适度增强而静态响应降低、费米能级向导带移动但没有带隙中缺陷态、吸收边发生 Burstein–Moss 型位移、近带边透明度提高且双折射减弱。
papers.future_en: Calculations at additional La concentrations are needed to establish quantitative doping trends, as the abstract explicitly notes; experimental measurements could test the predicted dielectric and optical changes.
papers.future_zh: 正如摘要所指出的，还需计算更多 La 浓度以确定定量掺杂趋势；实验测量则可检验所预测的介电和光学变化。
papers.tier_reason_en: The abstract presents a broad, internally connected set of predictions for a technologically relevant oxide, but the evidence is limited to one modeled concentration and computational results, making a specialist materials-physics tier the best fit.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 摘要针对具有应用意义的氧化物提出了一组相互关联的预测，但证据仅限于一个模型浓度和计算结果，因此专业材料物理期刊层级较为合适。

papers.title: Electrostatic edge effects versus edge doping in graphene nanoribbons: a scanning gate microscopy and modelling study
papers.authors: Colm Durkan, Xiao Liu, Ed Saunders
papers.summary_en: The study re-examines width-dependent charge-neutrality-point shifts in oxygen-plasma-patterned graphene nanoribbons and finds that gate-field fringing explains most of the trend, rather than intrinsic n-type edges. Its combined modeling, capacitance analysis, and scanning-gate measurements identify a smaller, device-dependent edge-charge contribution.
papers.summary: The charge neutrality point (CNP) of graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) patterned by oxygen plasma etching moves towards zero as the ribbon narrows and, on 300 nm SiO2, changes sign below a crossover width of ~ 50 nm: an observation previously attributed to n-type edges surrounding a p-type bulk. We test this edge-doping hypothesis in three ways. First, finite element modelling of complete GNR transistor
papers.abstract: The charge neutrality point (CNP) of graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) patterned by oxygen plasma etching moves towards zero as the ribbon narrows and, on 300 nm SiO2, changes sign below a crossover width of ~ 50 nm: an observation previously attributed to n-type edges surrounding a p-type bulk. We test this edge-doping hypothesis in three ways. First, finite element modelling of complete GNR transistors with uniform doping shows that fringing of the gate field at the edges reproduces the trend of the measured CNP with width down to ~ 50nm without any edge doping, while producing a bias-dependent inversion of the carrier type at the edges that mimics n-type edges in scanned-probe measurements. Second, fitting the CNP of ribbons on 90 nm and 300 nm SiO2 with the gate capacitance of a finite strip, which fixes the electrostatic contribution with no adjustable parameter other than the bulk doping, shows that fringing accounts for most of the width dependence and isolates the remainder as an edge charge. This is acceptor-like (0.24 e/nm per edge) in the present ribbons, which therefore have no n-type edges, and donor-like but small in devices on 300 nm SiO2; no single edge-charge, field-coupled or contact-doping mechanism describes both. Third, scanning gate microscopy finds no edge contrast of the sign expected for n-type edges. The width dependence of the CNP is therefore predominantly electrostatic, and n-type edges are not an intrinsic consequence of oxygen-plasma etching. A design map shows that fringing dominates the width dependence whenever the gate dielectric is thicker than 30-50 nm, whereas in scaled high-K transistors, edge charge dominates and would shift the threshold voltage of a 10 nm ribbon by ~ 0.1-0.15 V. Fitting the CNP versus width with the strip capacitance provides a simple test for edge doping in any gated two-dimensional nanostructure
papers.physics_advance: Gate-field fringing explains most of the width-dependent charge-neutrality-point shift and can mimic n-type edge signatures, while the measured edge charge in these ribbons is acceptor-like rather than n-type.
papers.relevance_reason: Measurements and modeling in graphene nanoribbons identify the physical origins of width-dependent charge-neutrality shifts, making this a credible, focused advance in two-dimensional electronic materials.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究重新考察氧等离子体刻蚀石墨烯纳米带中电荷中性点随宽度变化的现象，发现栅极电场边缘效应解释了其中大部分趋势，而非本征 n 型边缘。建模、电容分析和扫描门显微测量共同表明，边缘电荷的贡献较小且依赖器件条件。
papers.method_en: Finite-element modeling of complete transistors with uniform doping tests whether gate-field fringing can reproduce the observed width dependence; fitting finite-strip gate capacitance separates electrostatic effects from edge charge. Scanning gate microscopy independently tests for the expected signal of n-type edges.
papers.method_zh: 研究对均匀掺杂的完整晶体管进行有限元建模，以检验栅极电场边缘效应能否再现观测到的宽度依赖；通过拟合有限宽条带的栅极电容，区分静电效应与边缘电荷。另以扫描门显微术独立检验 n 型边缘应有的信号。
papers.result_en: Uniform-doping electrostatic modeling reproduces the charge-neutrality-point trend down to ribbon widths of about 50 nm and can generate a bias-dependent edge carrier-type inversion that mimics n-type edges in probe measurements. For the studied ribbons, the remaining fitted edge charge is acceptor-like, at 0.24 e/nm per edge, so the authors conclude that these ribbons do not have n-type edges; devices on 300 nm SiO₂ instead show a small donor-like edge charge. Scanning gate microscopy finds no edge contrast with the sign expected for n-type edges. The design analysis finds fringing dominates the width dependence when the gate dielectric is thicker than 30–50 nm, whereas in scaled high-K transistors edge charge dominates and would shift the threshold voltage of a 10 nm ribbon by about 0.1–0.15 V.
papers.result_zh: 均匀掺杂的静电模型可再现宽度低至约 50 nm 的纳米带电荷中性点趋势，并能产生随偏压变化的边缘载流子类型反转，从而在探针测量中模拟 n 型边缘。对所研究的纳米带，拟合得到的剩余边缘电荷为受主型，每条边缘为 0.24 e/nm，因此作者认为这些纳米带并无 n 型边缘；而在 300 nm SiO₂ 上的器件中，边缘电荷较小且为施主型。扫描门显微术未发现符号符合 n 型边缘预期的边缘对比信号。设计分析表明，当栅介质厚于 30–50 nm 时，边缘电场效应主导宽度依赖；而在缩放的高介电常数晶体管中，边缘电荷占主导，并可使 10 nm 纳米带的阈值电压移动约 0.1–0.15 V。
papers.future_en: The authors present fitting the charge-neutrality point versus width with strip capacitance as a simple test for edge doping in gated two-dimensional nanostructures. Their design map also identifies when electrostatic fringing or edge charge is expected to dominate, including the estimated threshold-voltage shift for a 10 nm ribbon.
papers.future_zh: 作者提出，将电荷中性点随宽度的变化拟合到条带电容，是检验栅控二维纳米结构中边缘掺杂的简便方法。其设计图还指出了静电边缘效应或边缘电荷分别占主导的条件，并给出了 10 nm 纳米带的阈值电压移动估计。
papers.tier_reason_en: The work combines complementary modeling and scanning-probe evidence to resolve a focused electrostatic interpretation question, with useful quantitative design implications; the abstract does not indicate the broader conceptual reach or advance warranting a higher tier.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 该工作结合互补的建模与扫描探针证据，厘清了一个范围明确的静电解释问题，并给出有用的定量设计启示；摘要所述成果尚未显示出足以支持更高档次的广泛概念影响或突破。

papers.title: Exact few-magnon Bethe scars of the non-integrable alternating Heisenberg chain
papers.authors: Ronald Melendrez, Bhaskar Mukherjee, Marcin Szyniszewski, Christopher J. Turner, Arijeet Pal, Hitesh J. Changlani
papers.summary_en: This work identifies exact few-magnon scar states in the non-integrable alternating ferromagnetic–antiferromagnetic Heisenberg chain and relates them to modified Bethe-ansatz constructions.
papers.summary: Exact solutions of quantum lattice models serve as useful guides for interpreting physical phenomena in condensed matter systems. Prominent examples of integrability appear in one dimension, including the Heisenberg chain, where the Bethe ansatz method has been widely successful. Recent work has noted that certain non-integrable models harbor quantum many-body scar states, which form a superspin o
papers.abstract: Exact solutions of quantum lattice models serve as useful guides for interpreting physical phenomena in condensed matter systems. Prominent examples of integrability appear in one dimension, including the Heisenberg chain, where the Bethe ansatz method has been widely successful. Recent work has noted that certain non-integrable models harbor quantum many-body scar states, which form a superspin of regular states hidden in an otherwise chaotic spectrum. Here we consider one of the simplest examples of a non-integrable model, the alternating ferromagnetic-antiferromagnetic (bond-staggered) Heisenberg chain, a close cousin of the spin-1 Haldane chain and a spin analog of the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, and show the presence of exponentially many zero-energy states. We highlight features of the alternating chain that allow treatment with the coordinate Bethe ansatz (with important modifications), and surprisingly, for a non-integrable system, we find simple compact expressions for zero-energy eigenfunctions for a few magnons, including solutions with fractionalized particle momentum. These states exhibit wavefunction scarring similar to that of single-particle states in chaotic billiards. We discuss a general numerical recipe to diagnose the existence of such generalized Bethe ansatz (GBA) scar states and also provide exact analytic expressions for their entanglement. We conclude by conjecturing a picture of magnon pairing which may generalize to multiple magnons. Our work opens the avenue to describe certain eigenstates of partially integrable systems using the GBA.
papers.physics_advance: Finds exponentially many zero-energy states and compact few-magnon scar eigenfunctions, including fractionalized-momentum solutions, in the alternating Heisenberg chain.
papers.relevance_reason: This develops exact results for many-body eigenstates and magnon excitations in a non-integrable quantum spin chain.
papers.summary_zh: 这项工作在非可积的交替铁磁—反铁磁 Heisenberg 链中识别出精确的少磁振子 scar 态，并将其与经过修改的 Bethe ansatz 构造联系起来。
papers.method_en: The authors adapt the coordinate Bethe ansatz to the alternating chain, derive compact few-magnon eigenfunctions, and provide a numerical diagnostic recipe and analytic entanglement expressions for generalized Bethe-ansatz scar states.
papers.method_zh: 作者将坐标 Bethe ansatz 推广至交替链，推导紧凑形式的少磁振子本征波函数，并给出广义 Bethe ansatz scar 态的数值诊断方案和解析纠缠表达式。
papers.result_en: The chain is shown to host exponentially many zero-energy states, including few-magnon solutions with fractionalized particle momentum; these states exhibit scarring, and the authors conjecture a magnon-pairing picture that may extend to multiple magnons.
papers.result_zh: 研究表明该链具有指数多的零能态，其中包括具有分数化粒子动量的少磁振子解；这些态呈现 scar 特征，作者还猜想一种可能推广至多磁振子的磁振子配对图景。
papers.future_en: Further work could test the conjectured pairing picture for multiple magnons and apply the proposed generalized Bethe-ansatz diagnostics to other partially integrable systems.
papers.future_zh: 后续研究可检验针对多磁振子的配对猜想，并将所提出的广义 Bethe ansatz 诊断方法应用于其他部分可积系统。
papers.tier_reason_en: The exact scar solutions, exponentially many zero-energy states, fractionalized momenta, and analytic entanglement results constitute a compact conceptual advance in non-integrable quantum dynamics, supporting a strong short-format physics tier.
papers.tier_reason_zh: 精确 scar 解、指数多零能态、分数化动量以及解析纠缠结果共同构成了对非可积量子动力学的集中概念性推进，足以支持较高水平的短篇物理期刊层级。

papers.title: Nontrivial Boundary-Mediated Superconducting Transport in a TRSB Topological Iron-Based Superconductor
papers.authors: Wenyao Liu, Gabriel Natale, Camron Farhang, Michael Geiwitz, Qishuo Tan, Xingyao Guo, Mason Gray, Vincent LambertiJazzmin Victorin, Huairuo Zhang, James L. Hart, Vsevolod Belosevich, Xi Ling, Qiong Ma, Wan Kyu Park, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Judy J. Cha, Albert V. Davydov, Kin Chung Fong, Ethan Arnault, Genda Gu, Rui-Xing Zhang, Enrico Rossi, Jing Xia, Kenneth S. Burch
papers.summary_en: This study reports evidence for boundary-mediated superconducting transport in FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅, where superconductivity, nontrivial band topology, and spontaneous time-reversal-symmetry breaking (TRSB) coexist. The transport signatures depend on composition, edge geometry, and the temperature scale associated with TRSB.

papers.abstract: The interplay of superconductivity, band topology, and spontaneous time-reversal-symmetry breaking (TRSB) is expected to enable topological superconducting boundary states. FeTe0.55Se0.45 provides a promising single-material platform because it combines superconductivity, nontrivial band topology, and spontaneous magnetization in the superconducting state. Here we report evidence for a boundary-mediated superconducting transport response in exfoliated Fe(Te,Se) devices. Polar Kerr measurements show that TRSB emerges below TKerr < Tc and coexists with superconductivity across multiple compositions, providing an independent symmetry-breaking scale for transport. Using crystallographically sharp, continuous edges and side-surface-dominant contacts, we find that topological FeTe0.55Se0.45 exhibits an anomalous conductance plateau absent in topologically trivial FeTe0.40Se0.60 and Fe1.02Te0.55Se0.45 under comparable measurements. This plateau requires uninterrupted sharp edges connecting source and drain, persists over micrometer-scale separations far exceeding the bulk coherence length, shows strongly suppressed thermal broadening, and collapses when the drain is moved to the top surface. Its temperature evolution follows the TRSB scale: the plateau remains weakly broadened below T*Kerr and disappears near TKerr rather than Tc. These doping-selective, edge-geometry-dependent, TRSB-correlated, and long-range nonlocal signatures establish experimental criteria for identifying boundary-mediated superconducting transport in FeTe0.55Se0.45 and motivate phase-sensitive and theoretical studies of its microscopic origin.
papers.physics_advance: In FeTe0.55Se0.45, an anomalous long-range, edge-mediated superconducting conductance plateau is associated with the TRSB temperature scale and absent in the compared topologically trivial compositions.
papers.relevance_reason: This experimental study probes superconducting transport and symmetry breaking in a condensed-matter material, reporting a distinctive edge-geometry-dependent response.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究报告了 FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ 中边界介导超导输运的证据；该材料同时具有超导性、非平庸能带拓扑和自发时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB）。输运特征取决于材料组分、边缘几何以及与 TRSB 相关的温度尺度。
papers.method_en: Polar Kerr measurements were used to identify the onset of TRSB across multiple compositions, and transport was measured in exfoliated devices with crystallographically sharp, continuous edges and side-surface-dominant contacts. Comparisons included topological FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ and two topologically trivial compositions, as well as changes in edge continuity, contact surface, separation, and temperature.
papers.method_zh: 研究通过极向克尔测量确定多个组分中 TRSB 的出现，并在具有晶体学上锋利且连续边缘、以侧表面接触为主的剥离器件中测量输运。比较对象包括拓扑非平庸的 FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ 和两种拓扑平庸组分，同时考察边缘连续性、接触表面、间距及温度的影响。
papers.result_en: A conductance plateau is observed in topological FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ but not in the two topologically trivial compositions under comparable measurements. The plateau requires uninterrupted sharp edges connecting source and drain, persists over micrometer-scale separations well beyond the bulk coherence length, and is strongly broadened less by temperature than expected for ordinary bulk transport. It collapses when the drain contact is moved to the top surface, and its temperature evolution tracks the TRSB scale: it remains weakly broadened below T*Kerr and disappears near TKerr rather than Tc. Together, the composition selectivity, edge-geometry dependence, long-range nonlocality, and correlation with TRSB support boundary-mediated superconducting transport.
papers.result_zh: 在拓扑非平庸的 FeTe₀.₅₅Se₀.₄₅ 中观察到电导平台，而在相同测量条件下的两种拓扑平庸组分中未观察到该平台。平台要求源极与漏极之间存在不间断的锋利边缘；即使两者相距数微米、远超体相相干长度，平台仍可存在，且其热展宽受到显著抑制。将漏极移至顶表面后，平台会消失；其温度演化与 TRSB 温标相符：低于 T*Kerr 时仅略有展宽，并在接近 TKerr 而非 Tc 时消失。组分选择性、对边缘几何的依赖、长程非局域性及与 TRSB 的关联共同支持边界介导超导输运的解释。
papers.future_en: The authors propose phase-sensitive measurements and theoretical studies to investigate the microscopic origin of the reported transport. The identified composition, geometry, nonlocality, and TRSB-related temperature dependence provide experimental criteria for further tests of boundary-mediated transport.
papers.future_zh: 作者提出开展相位敏感测量和理论研究，以探究所报告输运现象的微观起源。所识别的组分、几何、非局域性及与 TRSB 相关的温度依赖，为进一步检验边界介导输运提供了实验判据。

papers.title: Slave-boson Formalism for Superconducting Pairing at Strong Coupling
papers.authors: Sarbajit Mazumdar, Jonas Issing, Jannis Seufert, David Riegler, Peter Wölfle, Ronny Thomale, Michael Klett
papers.summary_en: This work develops a spin-rotation-invariant Kotliar–Ruckenstein slave-boson approach to superconducting pairing in the one-band Hubbard model at strong coupling.
papers.summary: We study the emergence of superconductivity in the one-band Hubbard model using the spin-rotation-invariant Kotliar-Ruckenstein slave-boson (SB) approach. Motivated by its intrinsically renormalized mean-field ground state, we construct an effective pairing vertex from dynamical fluctuations about the saddle point. Solving the anisotropic, frequency-dependent gap equation on the square lattice, we
papers.abstract: We study the emergence of superconductivity in the one-band Hubbard model using the spin-rotation-invariant Kotliar-Ruckenstein slave-boson (SB) approach. Motivated by its intrinsically renormalized mean-field ground state, we construct an effective pairing vertex from dynamical fluctuations about the saddle point. Solving the anisotropic, frequency-dependent gap equation on the square lattice, we map the pairing instabilities across doping, interaction, temperature and real-frequency gap structure that qualitatively match experimental cuprate observations. This framework merges strong-correlation SB-type renormalizations with RPA-type pairing transparency, providing a scalable route to modeling multi-orbital superconductivity at strong coupling.
papers.physics_advance: Constructs a dynamical pairing vertex from fluctuations around a spin-rotation-invariant slave-boson saddle point and maps superconducting instabilities across doping, interaction, and temperature.
papers.relevance_reason: This is a theoretical study of pairing in the Hubbard model, but its main advance is a modeling framework and broad instability mapping rather than a clearly isolated new material phenomenon.
papers.summary_zh: 这项工作发展了一种自旋旋转不变的 Kotliar–Ruckenstein slave-boson 方法，用于研究强耦合单带 Hubbard 模型中的超导配对。
papers.method_en: The authors construct an effective pairing vertex from dynamical fluctuations around the slave-boson saddle point and solve an anisotropic, frequency-dependent gap equation on the square lattice.
papers.method_zh: 作者从 slave-boson 鞍点附近的动力学涨落构造有效配对顶角，并在正方晶格上求解各向异性、含频率依赖的能隙方程。
papers.result_en: The resulting pairing instabilities across doping, interaction, temperature, and real-frequency gap structure qualitatively match experimental observations in cuprates, and the framework combines strong-correlation renormalization with RPA-like pairing transparency.
papers.result_zh: 所得配对不稳定性随掺杂、相互作用、温度和实频能隙结构的变化，在定性上与铜氧化物实验观察相符；该框架结合了强关联重整化与类似 RPA 的配对分析透明度。
papers.future_en: The proposed framework could be tested against additional cuprate observables and extended to multi-orbital systems, which the authors identify as a potential application.
papers.future_zh: 可通过更多铜氧化物观测量检验该框架，并将其扩展至多轨道体系，这是作者指出的潜在应用方向。

papers.title: Electronic properties and topological aspects of graphene nanohelicoids
papers.authors: Xiaoqian Liu, Arsen Herasymchuk, Yaroslav Zhumagulov, Oleg V. Yazyev
papers.summary_en: This work introduces graphene nanohelicoids and studies how their width and edge orientation shape their electronic bands and one-dimensional topological indices.
papers.summary: We introduce graphene nanohelicoids, geometric analogs of graphene nanoribbons, in which the honeycomb lattice is embedded on a helicoidal surface. Starting from the three-dimensional helical structure, we construct effective one-dimensional lattice models with band structures characterized by a momentum-shifted particle-hole relation $E_v(k)=-E_c(k+π)$ that reflects an antichiral symmetry arising
papers.abstract: We introduce graphene nanohelicoids, geometric analogs of graphene nanoribbons, in which the honeycomb lattice is embedded on a helicoidal surface. Starting from the three-dimensional helical structure, we construct effective one-dimensional lattice models with band structures characterized by a momentum-shifted particle-hole relation $E_v(k)=-E_c(k+π)$ that reflects an antichiral symmetry arising from the nonsymmorphic symmetry. A systematic investigation of graphene nanohelicoids using the tight-binding approximation reveals a number of trends upon varying width and edge orientation, for instance, alternating transitions between semiconducting and metallic regimes. As the structure width varies, the band gap periodically closes and reopens, accompanied by an alternating Zak phase that switches between trivial and nontrivial. Using an analytic tight-binding model with a continuous deformation of the graphene nanohelicoids, we explain the origin of width- and termination-dependent band inversion and alternating Zak phase, and derive the relationship between the termination-resolved index and the sublattice symmetry operator in one-dimensional nonsymmorphic systems.
papers.physics_advance: The study predicts width-dependent gap closing and reopening with alternating Zak phases in graphene nanohelicoids, and relates termination-resolved topology to sublattice symmetry in one-dimensional nonsymmorphic systems.
papers.relevance_reason: This is original theoretical work on electronic bands and topology in a proposed graphene-based solid-state structure.
papers.summary_zh: 这项工作提出石墨烯纳米螺旋体，并研究其宽度和边缘取向如何影响电子能带与一维拓扑指标。
papers.method_en: The authors construct effective one-dimensional models from helicoidal honeycomb lattices, analyze them using tight binding, and develop an analytic model with continuous deformation to explain band inversion and Zak-phase changes.
papers.method_zh: 作者从螺旋状蜂窝晶格构造有效一维模型，使用紧束缚方法进行分析，并建立可连续形变的解析模型以解释能带反转和 Zak 相变化。
papers.result_en: The bands obey a momentum-shifted particle-hole relation associated with nonsymmorphic antichiral symmetry, while varying width produces alternating semiconducting and metallic regimes and periodic gap closings and reopenings accompanied by alternating trivial and nontrivial Zak phases.
papers.result_zh: 能带满足与非对称操作反手征对称性相关的动量平移粒子—空穴关系；随宽度变化，体系在半导体和金属状态间交替，并周期性地经历带隙闭合与重开，伴随平庸和非平庸 Zak 相交替。
papers.future_en: Further work could examine how the predicted width- and termination-dependent topological distinctions manifest in transport or other measurable properties of nanohelicoids.
papers.future_zh: 后续研究可考察所预测的宽度依赖和终止方式依赖拓扑差异如何体现在纳米螺旋体的输运或其他可测性质中。
